comparison.objective: Configure a meter test switch safely and insert a current test plug.
comparison.physical_skill: Manipulate multiple guarded knife switches and align a flat probe with spring contacts while respecting electrical interlocks.
comparison.success_condition: Specified voltage and phase-A switches open safely, plug seated and retained under a push-back check; unsafe switch states score zero.
comparison.reason: Tests ordered interlocked switching and electrical-test-plug insertion, not mechanical angle adjustment and counterlocked retention.
